'''Gularg Libation Emporium''' was a bar owned by [[Gularg]] the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] in [[Celanon City]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Celanon/Legends|Celanon]] that had a near legendary reputation of being the rowdiest, seediest and most dangerous tavern in the area. It was also considered to be the best place in the [[City/Legends|city]] for [[Smuggler/Legends|smugglers]] to be able to find employment.
